RTTI/vtable licensing for the promotion wave: this TU is dMeter_c's key-function TU, so the object emits _ZTV8dMeter_c (0x50) plus the _ZTI/_ZTS ancestor chain (dMeter_c, dBase_c, fBase_c) into .data. 'sections' is deliberately left .text-only -- text-verified establishes no data interval. The blocker is upstream of licensing: config/arm9/overlays/ov002/symbols.txt names _ZTV8dMeter_c at 0x0210c2c8, but the __si_class_type_info record at 0x0210c224 points its name word at 0x0210c218, where the overlay bytes read '8dMeter_c' (10 bytes incl NUL) against the 5 bytes _ZTS8dMeter_c needs. Different spelling and different length, so the emitted .data passengers cannot byte-match the cartridge under the name dMeter_c; the _ZTI base word resolves to dBase_c (arm9 0x02086e78). Promoting this TU data-verified requires the rename to dMeter_c first. Not a text-verification concern: all 19 .text functions match exactly.

include/dMeter_c.h does not declare four of this TU's nineteen members -- RenderLifeCount, RenderCameraButtons, RenderCoinCount and UpdateVsTimer -- and a member cannot be added to a class from outside it. They are defined here in the hand-mangled extern "C" free-function form this tree already uses for that case, taking the object as an explicit first parameter; the ABI is identical (the object still arrives in r0) and all four byte-match. Their callers inside this same TU already spelled them that way. Separately, InitResources and RenderLifeCount read fields include/dMeter_c.h leaves unnamed (0x62, 0x64, 0x6e, 0x78) or names at a wider type than the ROM's load proves (u16 mVsTimer at 0x60 against the s16 the legacy source used); those reads are spelled as offset casts at the legacy types rather than widening a load or editing a shared header from a fold. Whoever promotes this TU should consider naming those fields in include/dMeter_c.h, which is a declaration-gate change and not this fold's to make.
